import importlib.util, os, time
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('rc', 'tools/registry-check.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
class Dummy: pid = 0
n_proc = sum(1 for e in os.listdir('/proc') if e.isdecimal())
t = time.perf_counter(); snap = m._process_snapshot(); d_snap = time.perf_counter() - t
t = time.perf_counter(); owned = m._row_owned_processes(Dummy(), frozenset(), None); d_owned = time.perf_counter() - t
t = time.perf_counter(); owned2 = m._row_owned_processes(Dummy(), frozenset(), None); d_owned2 = time.perf_counter() - t
print('host_processes', n_proc, 'snapshot_entries', len(snap))
print('snapshot_seconds %.3f' % d_snap)
print('row_owned_processes_seconds_call1 %.3f owned=%d' % (d_owned, len(owned)))
print('row_owned_processes_seconds_call2 %.3f owned=%d' % (d_owned2, len(owned2)))
print('loadavg', open('/proc/loadavg').read().split()[:3])
